title: Mixed Event — Happy New Year! Lion Dance Robot's New Year's Show! — Episode7 New Year's Connections

meta.Event: Happy New Year! Lion Dance Robot's New Year's Show!
meta.Event Outline: After successfully wrapping up their ambassadorial performances, Wonderlands×Showtime is preparing to put on a New Year's show at the new and improved Wonder Stage. Unfortunately, Lion Dance Robot seems to be feeling a bit under the weather...

rows.Line: The next day
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's almost time... Oh!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Sorry, Ichi!
Thanks for waiting!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, that's okay. I just got here a second ago. Anyway, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. The New Year's party at Shiho's is gonna be so much fun♪ I'm so excited that I brought a ton of mochi!

Hm...?
What's this? Fancy seeing you two here.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh! Airi!
Happy New Year!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Happy New Year!
Are you two about to go somewhere?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yes!
We're going to Shiho's house.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, nice!
Sounds like you're both really enjoying New Year's♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We are. We just went to the beach yesterday to see the first sunrise, so we have been fairly busy...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And we got to be in Tsukasa and his troupe's show♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Their show...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hang on. You're not talking about the one with the Lion Dance Deity, are you?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Huh? Yeah, it was that one!
How did you know...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehehe. We also got to participate in that very same show!

rows.Speaker: Saki & Ichika
rows.Line: What?!
Penguin Cafe

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
What?
An, you saw that show too?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, they came to the ski resort we were at! And I didn't just watch... I sort of got to be in it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Really? We got to be in it too, as dancers from the village they were visiting.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Cool! So that's how your version went!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Wasn't it so much fun?
I'd love to be in another show like that in the future.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You definitely should. I think it suits you really well since you've got a lot of charisma.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. I just might if you want me to so much, Haruka. I mean, I can always switch tracks and try to become an actress...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
An actress...?
That sounds nice, but is that what you really want to do?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hmm...
It seems like fun, but...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'll pass! It's not what I want to do the most!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, I had a feeling you'd say that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, my dear childhood friend!
You know me too well♪

rows.Speaker: Waiter
rows.Line:
Thank you for your patience!
Here's your limited-edition New Year's penguin paradise parfait and rum raisin ice cream!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, nice timing!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
It's so cute...!
I have to take a picture...!
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Wait, Hinomori...
You also got to see that show?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I did!
It's incredible that they also did a performance at the mall. I really had no idea...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I agree.
They must've been very active throughout New Year's Day...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: At the same time, you just climbed a mountain yesterday, and you're about to go shopping with Momoi, no?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. There's a sweets shop that sells this red bean soup that I've been meaning to try. Would you like to join us, Asahina?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Maybe. I still have some time until I need to meet back up with my family...

Huh?
Mafuyu? And Shizuku?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Huh? Mizuki...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hi, Mizuki!
Oh, you have company. What brings you all here today...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hello.
And Happy New Year.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, right! Happy New Year, Shizuku! We actually just ran into each other a second ago!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Li'l Bro here said that he's gonna go try the red bean soup at that shop over there, so I decided to tag along♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, I see!
Airi and I are here to do the same thing. I'll be meeting her there.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Why don't we all go together?
You too, Asahina. How does that sound...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I suppose I can stay until I hear from my family...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Really? Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, Mafuyu, you gotta hear this!
Li'l Bro said he and his team also saw Tsukasa's show!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It was a wonderful, happy show to welcome in the new year.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: To be fair, seeing that Lion Dance Robot wandering around startled a lot of us...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Lion Dance Robot...?
We saw that show too!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wait, Shizuku, you did?
Talk about a big coincidence!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Then, let's talk more about it over at the cafe! C'mon, you guys!
Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Are you okay, Ms. Yoisaki?
You're carrying quite a lot, so maybe we should stop and take a break.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I-I'm so sorry, Ms. Mochizuki...
I didn't mean for this to happen when I asked you to go shopping with me...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You're going over to your friend's house this afternoon for a party, yes? If you're pressed for time, please feel free to go...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. It's okay.
I still have plenty of time.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: More importantly... I hope you find a nice place in your father's hospital room for that mini mochi set that you just bought.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Me too...
We always have it on display during New Year's, so I hope he likes it...

Huff... Huff...
Maybe I should stop here... Plus, it's freezing...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Huh...?
That looks like... Kanade?! Honami?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wh-What are you two doing here?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
We were just out shopping...
What were you doing just now, Ena? Running?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, so...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Wait, I can't tell them that I'm running because I ate too much during the holidays and how Akito's poking fun at me for it...!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: R-Remember that show we saw yesterday by that troupe from PXL...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Seeing that made me want to be more active... Haha...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
PXL...?
Are you talking about the show that Emu's troupe did?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Huh?
Wait, Ms. Mochizuki, did you also see it?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Um... Yes, but not at the mall.
I saw it at the beach...

rows.Speaker: Kanade & Ena
rows.Line: The beach?!
Main Street

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, to summarize...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: After doing a show at the beach, Tsukasa and his troupe did another one on top of a mountain and then at a ski resort...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Th-That's amazing...!
It's like a surprise tour!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The show itself was really short, but it must've been really hard to pull off something like that...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: At the same time, it's must've been really fun! A concert tour's one thing... But a show tour!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It actually seems like something they'd do...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah, I agree!
Oh, Shiho, sorry for keeping you! We know you have a New Year's party to get to...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
No, don't mind me.
I still have some time until we're supposed to meet up.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You two are meeting up with Kiritani and Shiraishi, right? Try not to be late, okay?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, right!
They said that they're already there, so maybe we should get going.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Okay!
Oh, Shiho...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hm? Yeah?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I nearly forgot to say... Happy New Year!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Let's go to PXL together again sometime.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Hehe. Sure.
And Happy New Year to the both of you.
